## Result and limits

Add the complete proof-plus-audit edition for **2307034 / AMR-022-7034**, Hall Problem 7.34. **UNRESOLVED, 1/5 substantive approaches consumed.** The unrestricted arbitrary-positive-irrational-exponent complex case is not solved.

The accepted partial results prove N<=ceil(B)+n for real parameters, for tuples whose nonreal parameters lie in the closed left half-plane, and for all admissible complex tuples with n<=2. The exact sharp N=4 claim is confined to the exponent tuple (3/5,3/5). The elementary rational-exponent bound is N<=qB+1.

Both exact proposed-bound counterexamples and the complete 14-entry rational coefficient table are preserved in the proof and mathematical audit. The four-parameter tuple with all exponents 21/10 has its first nonpositive coefficient at index 14 and refutes ceil(B)+n=13. Its universal lower bound is 14 and its established rational upper bound is 85; **14 is not claimed sharp**. Neither example contradicts Hall's existence statement.

## Editorial and acceptance boundary

The full mathematical derivations and independent audit discussion are retained. The sole mathematical wording clarification is in Section 8: a small positive parameter creates a denominator zero and logarithmic-derivative pole; it is a branch singularity only when the corresponding merged exponent is nonintegral. No theorem or coefficient changes.

The original audit binds the original proof (13,273 bytes, SHA-256 `fa99237c49ed63a529c8b5f30ebdb6e62cf516b648e2a5a3aa8b9983cdbed71e`). The edited proof is separately identified (12994 bytes, SHA-256 `7911a494baefcaf561d26ef8cf8c4cb5ba853834bbc461e10988fc95e80924d7`). The original audit is 18,888 bytes, SHA-256 `d81979ab8ec29bed9b51315ef1b86317d598a4c9907cc3296392325586b2d7d7`; its present editorial edition is 17050 bytes, SHA-256 `4c753588c70b81f6355612531d716db499d24c0f1fea07dbb37797dded8bd478`. ACCEPTANCE.json and PROVENANCE.md explicitly distinguish all of these objects. The original proof hash is not presented as an identity for the edited proof.

Source: Hayman and Lingham, [Research Problems in Function Theory (New Edition), arXiv:1809.07200v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/1809.07200v2), revised 21 September 2018, Problem 7.34 at printed p.170 / PDF p.171. The preserved [public PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1809.07200v2) has 1,706,228 bytes and SHA-256 `8e28fd4403a07e4e19a9816b7efaafddf9f475d59cf8c34a8255cb03833ed4f0`. The 2018 update is not a certification of present-day open status. No novelty, exhaustive literature review, human peer-review acceptance, or formal proof-assistant certification is claimed; the work is AI-assisted and unrefereed.

## Scope and checks

Exactly eight authored text/metadata files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/2307034/`: README.md, PROOF.md, AUDIT.md, SOURCE_LEDGER.md, PROVENANCE.md, ACCEPTANCE.json, STATUS.json, and MANIFEST.json. No scripts, fixtures, checker outputs, copied source text/PDFs/images, dataset contents, private material, or excluded derived-source/computational identities are included. Already-authored mathematical tables and derivations are retained; excluded artifacts are not repackaged as prose.

The original input identities and stored public PDF identity match. Mathematical section/table preservation, complete manifest coverage, exact allowlist, excluded-content screening, and a fresh isolated `git apply` byte-for-byte replay passed. The replay target tree agrees with Git's own tree hash. The base root and subtree hashes were independently reconstructed before applying the additive tree transformation.

Base commit: `f6caddda8f8be2cdb3e91494325d8f7f365bc3fc`. All prior files and sibling subtrees, including QUEUE.md and external target 5100002, remain unchanged. Draft only; no merge, release, or deployment.

Manifest external identity: MANIFEST.json, 1321 bytes, SHA-256 `1bb522bb47e8063fcf65bfd3ee85b009fd2304b400842e145f61d961dc641c35`. It lists every delivered file except itself, avoiding self-hash circularity.
